title: The Legendary Titan of Fate/Quotes
summary:
What are you doing here, Cherit? This is my dream!"
- Lok Lambert to Cherit

"The Ring of Arc doesn't give. It only takes."
- Clements to Lok Lambert

"Seal it away. There's nothing in that Ring for us but sadness."
- Dante Vale to Clements
